_comment: BASELINE catalogue used only when a live catalogue cannot be fetched. The authoritative catalogue is queried at warm time (Voices API voices.list() and, for Live sessions, a real session open) and cached in the store. Committed on 2026-10-20 because the owner's machine is the only place with a key; every entry below is traceable to Google's published docs or to the Gemini Live app voice roster.
sources: https://ai.google.dev/api/voices (Voices API ListVoices; prebuilt id = speaker name)
Gemini Live app voice roster: Flare, Glow, Ursa, Vega, Pegasus, Dipper, Eclipse, Capella, Orbit, Orion (rolled out 2026-05-28; Flare/Glow replaced Nova/Lyra)

gemini-3.8-live.notes: GA 2026-09-15; default Live model for low-latency voice agents. Runtime validation fetches the real catalogue; this baseline lists the documented studio voices plus the Gemini Live app roster (Flare/Glow are app voices and are the ones most likely to differ per project).

gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking.notes: High-reasoning Live variant; same native-audio output contract.

gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview.notes: Flash Live preview on the Gemini Developer API (2026-03-26).
